answer_1.quote: Training open-domain dialog models is inherently difficult... We created an interactive, online platform which hosted a diverse set of neural network dialog models that users could chat with in real time.

answer_2.quote: We compute a large collection (30 in total) of bot rewards... such as sentiment or conversation length... and compute metrics based on their implicit satisfaction.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 80 Mechanical Turk workers to provide a total of 600 7-point Likert scale ratings of the trained bots, after interacting with each for at least 6 turns.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated bots on a 7-point Likert scale after conversations.
